## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the proposed feature.

## Problem Statement

What problem does this feature solve?

## Proposed Solution

How do you suggest implementing this feature?

## Use Cases

- Who would use this feature?
- In what scenarios would it be helpful?

## Evidence and Sources

- **Official Framework Reference**: (RGESN, GR491, Opquast, RGAA section number)
- **Source URL**: (link to official documentation)
- **Justification**: Why is this important for Green IT/responsible digital?

## Impact Assessment

### Environmental Impact
- [ ] Reduces carbon footprint
- [ ] Reduces energy consumption
- [ ] Reduces data usage
- [ ] Improves resource efficiency
- [ ] Other: ___________

### Accessibility Impact
- [ ] Improves accessibility (RGAA compliance)
- [ ] No impact on accessibility
- [ ] May affect accessibility: ___________

### Performance Impact
- [ ] Improves performance
- [ ] Neutral performance impact
- [ ] May affect performance: ___________
